name: Notebook 检查器
description: 不执行任何 cell，静态检查本地 .ipynb：cell 大纲、有界预览、历史错误与执行顺序提示，并可导出去除 outputs/execution_count 的清洗副本。

display_description.en: Statically inspect local .ipynb files without executing anything: cell outline, bounded previews, recorded errors and execution-order hints, plus safe export of cleaned copies.
display_description.zh: 不执行任何单元格，静态读取本地 notebook：大纲、预览、报错与执行顺序提示，可导出清洗副本。

default_init_input.zh: 检查 analysis.ipynb：列出 cell 大纲、执行顺序提示和记录到的报错，再导出一份去掉输出的干净副本。
default_init_input.en: Inspect analysis.ipynb: list the cell outline, execution-order hints and recorded errors, then export a cleaned copy without outputs.

quick_inputs.zh: 检查 analysis.ipynb：列出 cell 大纲、执行顺序提示和记录到的报错，再导出一份去掉输出的干净副本。
quick_inputs.en: Inspect analysis.ipynb: list the cell outline, execution-order hints and recorded errors, then export a cleaned copy without outputs.

quick_inputs.zh: 这个 notebook 上次运行时在哪个 cell 报了什么错？
quick_inputs.en: Which cell failed last time this notebook ran, and with what error?

quick_inputs.zh: 把 report.ipynb 清洗后另存为新文件，去掉所有输出和执行计数。
quick_inputs.en: Save a cleaned copy of report.ipynb as a new file with outputs and execution counts removed.

display_description.en: Read-only .ipynb JSON inspection (outline, bounded previews, errors, execution-order hints) and safe export of cleaned copies; never executes cells.
display_description.zh: 只读解析 .ipynb JSON：cell 大纲、有界预览、历史错误与执行顺序提示，并可安全导出去除输出的清洗副本；绝不执行任何 cell。
